entities.name: Ana Álvaro
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ana Belén Álvaro Bascuñana is a former Spanish basketball player, representing Spain from 1988 to 2002 and winning a gold medal at the 1993 European Championship. At club level, she won the 1993 FIBA European Champions Cup and 6 Liga Femenina titles.
